finding: The published canonical answers for the APSTATS-SFRQ-* family are the rubric's own learner_facing_text, not student answers. They are written in third-person rubric voice with criterion-key prefixes -- "a1) States the median is 22 minutes." rather than "The median commute time is 22 minutes." This is live Production content that Open Hand shows students as the full-credit exemplar. It is NOT a work order C defect: C was instructed to preserve existing text verbatim and did so correctly.
evidence: Measured over 134 span-by-criterion pairs after stripping the a1)/b1) prefixes: mean word-level similarity to the criterion's own learner_facing_text is 0.405 overall, and 0.652 for the APSTATS-SFRQ family, where 28 of 56 pairs are at or above 0.85. 32 pairs are at or above 0.95, several character-identical -- e.g. APSTATS-SFRQ-013 [a], answer and criterion are both exactly "States H0: mu = 70 and Ha: mu != 70." 18 of the 34 in-scope items carry at least one such span; all 14 SFRQ items do.
recommended_action: Product Owner decision on re-authoring these 14 SFRQ canonical answers as student-voice answers. They are the same defect class work order B was explicitly warned about ("rubric restatements, not answers"), except already published rather than proposed. Until then these items should not be used as grading exemplars.
